section.title: MVP Metrics
section.description: - List the key data points and methods for collecting them to measure the MVP's success. - Define success thresholds for each key performance indicator. - Non-functional requirements (from Section 6.2) are also validated here or through dedicated release testing. - Keep each NFR's value, unit, population, and measurement condition intact. Daily active users and concurrent users are different quantities.

subsection.title: Data Collection Methods
subsection.example: | Metric | Collection Method | Related Feature/KPI | |--------|-------------------|---------------------| | Revisit count within 14 days | User session tracking | KPI | | Authentication and password storage checks | Release verification of protected actions and non-plaintext password storage | NF1 | | Daily-user workload | One-day release workload with 1,000 distinct active users; record response latency | NF2, NF3 | | Average response latency | Request-to-response timing, using the p95 percentile | NF3 |

subsection.title: Success Thresholds
subsection.description: Define the target values that indicate MVP success.
subsection.example: | KPI | Baseline | Target | Measurement Period | |-----|----------|--------|-------------------| | Revisit rate (14 days) | N/A | ≥ 30% | Ongoing | | Authentication and password storage (NF1) | N/A | Authentication required; no plaintext passwords | Release verification | | Daily active users served (NF2) | N/A | ≥ 1,000 daily active users while meeting NF3 | One-day release workload | | Response latency (NF3) | N/A | < 3 seconds (p95) | Ongoing and during the NF2 workload |
